title: Thin, mediocre quality, goofy measurements, can't recommend
text: Thin, mediocre quality, goofy measurements, can't recommend. Much lighter than expected even over a bedspread in summer air conditioning. I hate the tag sewn into the edge seam. No way to hide what's left after cutting it off or removing it without risking integrity of the edge threads  plus measurements are whacked. At best its a coverlet only for looks and to protect a bedspread from pets or kids. Don't expect warmth in any capacity. A pillow sham laundered twice already started to pill and fuzz. I have a high full mattress and it's a pain when I take I this off to figure out which way it goes back on. I wish I had purchased a traditional blanket or 2 and almost did returning this one but the first one was lost in delivery and I needed a blanket fast so I just reordered .......one of those things I regret but making the best of it. I hate shopping but this is one time I should have hit Walmart, Target, Biglots or ANY Real store
